name: Session
description: A specific instance of work or interaction on a Molecule, controlled by a Lead Point.

attributes.name: moleculeId
attributes.description: The ID of the Molecule this Session is associated with.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning Lead Point — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning Lead Point or an admin may update or delete this session.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the session.

attributes.name: startTime
attributes.description: The start time of the session.

attributes.name: endTime
attributes.description: The end time of the session.
